scripts.setup: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm run db:create -w backend && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w admin
scripts.test: npm test -w backend && npm test -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w admin
